## Environment

| `duckdb` | 2.0.0 | runtime |
| `geopandas` | 1.2.0 | runtime |
| `matplotlib` | 3.11.2 | runtime |
| `numpy` | 2.5.4 | runtime |
| `openpyxl` | 3.1.5 | runtime |
| `pandas` | 3.0.6 | runtime |
| `polars` | 2.0.0 | runtime |
| `pyarrow` | 26.0.0 | runtime |
| `requests` | 2.34.2 | runtime |
| `scipy` | 1.18.1 | runtime |
| `statsmodels` | 0.15.0 | runtime |
| `xlrd` | 2.0.2 | runtime |
| `pypdf` | 6.21.2 | dev |
| `pytest` | 9.1.1 | dev |
| `ruff` | 0.17.1 | dev |

## Build targets (`Makefile`)

Each `make` target, what it depends on and what it runs, in the order of the Makefile. Network targets (`data`, `h6-data`) and the write-once confirmatory runs (`rq1-confirm`; `aideleg.confirm_h5`, which has no target) are listed as written and are never part of an offline rebuild.

```{=latex}
\begin{landscape}\scriptsize\raggedright
```

| target | depends on | runs |
|----|------|------|
| `all` | `lint`, `test` | its prerequisites only |
| `test` | nothing | `uv run pytest -v` |
| `lint` | nothing | `uv run ruff check` |
| `data` | nothing | `uv run python -m aideleg.acquire` |
| `panel` | `data/derived/aei_panel.parquet` | its prerequisites only |
| `data/derived/aei_panel.parquet` | `$(wildcard src/aideleg/aei/*.py)`, `src/aideleg/aei/metric_map.csv`, `src/aideleg/config.py`, `src/aideleg/acquire/sources.py`, `src/aideleg/market/french.py`, `data/raw/MANIFEST.json` | `uv run python -m aideleg.aei` |
| `exposure` | `data/derived/exposure_ff49.parquet` | its prerequisites only |
| `data/derived/exposure_ff49.parquet` | `src/aideleg/exposure.py`, `src/aideleg/occupations.py`, `src/aideleg/aei/tasks.py`, `src/aideleg/config.py`, `src/aideleg/acquire/sources.py`, `src/aideleg/market/french.py`, `$(wildcard src/aideleg/bls/*.py)`, `$(wildcard src/aideleg/crosswalk/*.py)`, `data/raw/MANIFEST.json`, `data/derived/aei_panel.parquet` | `uv run python -m aideleg.exposure` |
| `benchmarks` | `data/derived/benchmark_ff49.parquet` | its prerequisites only |
| `data/derived/benchmark_ff49.parquet` | `src/aideleg/benchmarks.py`, `src/aideleg/exposure.py`, `src/aideleg/config.py`, `src/aideleg/acquire/sources.py`, `src/aideleg/market/french.py`, `$(wildcard src/aideleg/bls/*.py)`, `$(wildcard src/aideleg/crosswalk/*.py)`, `data/raw/MANIFEST.json`, `data/derived/exposure_ff49.parquet` | `uv run python -m aideleg.benchmarks` |
| `audit` | `data/derived/aei_panel.parquet`, `data/derived/exposure_ff49.parquet`, `data/derived/benchmark_ff49.parquet` | `uv run python -m aideleg.audit` |
| `power-unfrozen` | nothing | `uv run python -c "import sys; from aideleg.market.seal import pap_frozen; sys.exit('pap-v1 exists: the power analysis is frozen, not rerun' if pap_frozen() else 0)"` |
| `power` | `power-unfrozen`, `data/derived/exposure_ff49.parquet` | `uv run python -m aideleg.power` |
| `freeze` | nothing | `uv run python scripts/pap_freeze.py` |
| `rq1-dry-run` | nothing | `uv run python -m aideleg.rq1.confirm --dry-run $${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/aideleg-rq1-dry` |
| `rq1-confirm` | nothing | `uv run python -m aideleg.rq1.confirm` |
| `results-rq1` | nothing | `uv run python -m aideleg.results.rq1` |
| `results-rq2` | nothing | `uv run python -m aideleg.results.rq2` |
| `results` | `results-rq1`, `results-rq2` | its prerequisites only |
| `rq3` | `data/derived/exposure_ff49.parquet` | `uv run python -m aideleg.rq3 all` |
| `h6-data` | nothing | `uv run python -m aideleg.h6 acquire` |
| `h6` | `data/derived/exposure_ff49.parquet` | `uv run python -m aideleg.h6 all` |
| `robustness` | `data/derived/exposure_ff49.parquet` | `uv run python -m aideleg.robustness --offline`; `uv run python -m aideleg.robustness --summary` |
| `figures-check` | nothing | `uv run python -c "from pathlib import Path; d = Path('docs/paper/figures'); pdf = {p.stem for p in d.glob('*.pdf')}; png = {p.stem for p in d.glob('*.png')}; odd = sorted(pdf ^ png); print('figures without a PDF/PNG twin:', odd) if odd else None; raise SystemExit(1 if odd else 0)"` |
| `paper-includes` | nothing | `uv run python -m aideleg.paper` |
| `paper` | `paper-includes` | `quarto render docs/paper --to pdf`; `quarto render docs/paper --to html` |
| `brief` | `paper-includes` | `quarto render docs/paper/brief.qmd --to pdf` |

```{=latex}
\end{landscape}
```

## Seed

The seed is `aideleg.config.SEED`, equal to 20261021. Every random draw comes from `numpy.random.default_rng(SEED)` (PAP §0.2).

## Replication

The steps to rebuild every result, table, figure and this paper from a clone (or an archive without `.git`) are in `README.md` at the repository root.
